English: Wild Vine Patch
A rough clearing in the wilds, where hardy Iberian grapevines are left to grow among the brush. Tended by a handful of nomads, it is a humble start to a grand dream.
Trellised Vine
Simple wooden trellises are erected, allowing vines to flourish and be more easily harvested. The beginnings of proper cultivation increase both yield and clan pride.
Harvest Shelter
Temporary canvas shelters and brush huts are erected in the vineyard for seasonal workers, improving grape gathering and supporting larger harvests.
Wine Press Hut
A sturdy timber hut houses the first hand-turned wine press, allowing for more efficient production and storage of the precious grape must.
Aged Barrel Room
A low, stone-lined cellar is dug into the earth, fitted with imported oak barrels for aging wine. The clans reputation for fine vintages grows considerably.
Walled Vineyard
Low stone walls encircle the now sprawling vineyard, protecting it against wild animals, thieves, and the elements. Order and security greatly increase output.
Merchants Winehouse
A bustling timber and stone building, complete with storerooms, tasting chambers, and a trading post, drawing merchants and travelers from afar.
Vintners Pavilion
A splendid tented pavilion serves as both a center for wine judging and a symbol of prestige. The best grapes are selected here, and the clans renown swells.
Cellar Hall
A grand, stone-vaulted cellar beneath the vines, filled with barrels and jars. It is both a place of storage and a meeting hall for the clans leaders and merchants.
Iberian Grand Winery
A sprawling estate of stone halls, vast cellars, and bustling markets, the Grand Winery is renowned from Castile to Cathay. The entire clan flourishes in its shadow.
